Game Overview

In Santa Stick, the core idea is straightforward: guide Santa across snowy platforms using his magical stick, where precision is key. Tap to grow the stick to the perfect length, bridging gaps and avoiding a festive fall. With increasing difficulty and charming Christmas graphics, test your timing skills in this delightful, endlessly entertaining challenge. Can you beat your high score?
